description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_StringHash' that extends ArrayObject to keep track of key accesses within an array-like structure, mainly used for tracking which keys were accessed.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_StringHash
classes.description: A class extending ArrayObject that records which keys are accessed in the array.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Overrides ArrayObject's offsetGet to log access to a key before returning its value.

methods.name: getAccessed
methods.description: Returns an array of all keys that have been accessed.
